FRHIGlobals::IsRHIInitialized sits 0x10 bytes before SupportsMultithreading in the same engine RHI globals struct; the address of SupportsMultithreading is the one the loader's scan resolves by name, so this is a distance inside an engine struct (rendering hardware interface), not a game member offset. Read-only, checked for readability, and a failed read leaves the capture off

same distance as in BuildingSpriteRenderer.cpp: FRHIGlobals::IsRHIInitialized is 0x10 bytes before SupportsMultithreading in the engine's RHI globals struct; engine layout, not a game member, and the readback path refuses to start when the bool is not set

FTextureRenderTargetResource (the render-target resource the engine returns) to its FRenderTarget base subobject (+0x50, after FTextureResource): C++ multiple-inheritance layout of engine classes, fixed by the engine version; the getter in that base's vtable is compared against the expected code bytes before it is called

end of a RIP-relative LEA instruction (anchor + 0x15, 7 bytes) found by a fingerprint of the matched code, used only to decode the displacement to GUObjectArray; the plugin scan API has no follow-RIP-at-offset call. A code-shape distance inside a matched pattern, not a member offset; the opcode bytes are verified first and a mismatch fails the scan
